name: Astral Awakening
description: After surviving 5 enemy attacks in the same battle, restore 25 HP + 25 Mana and gain +2 to your next offensive roll. Activates once per battle.
memories:
In the middle of battle, your thoughts suddenly drift toward that suspicious shopkeeper with the mustache who definitely wasn't Shizuki.

You have absolutely no idea why you're thinking about them right now.

...The mustache wasn't even convincing.

Somehow, you feel determined to keep going.

You remember your glorious Fae healing unit arriving to Mend your wounds.

Tiny lights. Tiny leaves. An alarming amount of confidence.

Somewhere among them, you are fairly certain somebody was arguing about workplace procedure.

You've survived worse management than this.

For reasons beyond your understanding, you suddenly remember the supervising leaf.

It said nothing.

It did nothing.

It supervised.

You cannot disappoint it now.

You remember the first time your Bubble took an enemy attack personally.

The wobble.

The indignation.

The deeply offended *boing*.

Perhaps you should try being equally difficult to pop.

Your thoughts drift toward one of the Jellyfish you've summoned along the way.

You don't remember which one.

It might have been brave.

It might have been sleepy.

It might have been deeply upset about being here.

Either way, it tried its best.

So will you.

You remember watching an Astral Charge attach itself directly to an enemy's forehead.

They tried to shake it off.

It stayed.

You stared at them.

They stared at you.

Somehow, remembering this fills you with strength.

You remember all the mysterious Berries you've encountered throughout your journey.

Healing Berries. Mana Berries. Exploding Berries.

At some point, you really should have started questioning where these things come from.

This is probably not the time.

Your life briefly flashes before your eyes.

For some reason, a Sour Berry is prominently featured.

You still remember the taste.

You refuse to let that be one of your final memories.

Somewhere in the back of your mind, you imagine the Fae Ancestors holding an emergency meeting about your current condition.

Several tiny elf voices begin arguing at once.

Somebody produces a leaf.

Nobody appears to know why.

You decide to survive before they make things worse.

You remember calling a star down from the Astral Sea with absolute confidence.

Your aim was perfect.

The star was terrible.

You perfectly aimed a really crappy star.

You've recovered from greater disappointments than this.

You remember the first time you called into the distant Astral Sea and something answered.

For several terrifying moments, nothing happened.

Then the water moved.

You remember thinking that perhaps summoning enormous sea creatures was a questionable combat strategy.

You have continued doing it anyway.

A tiny light flickers somewhere in your memory.

Shizuki's travel companion Glimmer.

For just a moment, the chaos of battle feels strangely far away.

You've traveled farther across the Astral Sea than you realized.

You're not finished exploring yet.

You suddenly remember every Star Candy you've collected, spent, gambled, dropped, discovered, and handed directly back to that definitely-not-Shizuki shopkeeper.

You begin to wonder whether this entire economy is suspicious.

The thought is strangely invigorating.

For just a moment, the battlefield grows strangely quiet.

Somewhere beyond the noise, you hear a familiar little giggle.

You can't tell whether it's a memory or something carried through the Astral Sea.

Either way, you suddenly remember how far you've come.

Keep going.

Your thoughts race through everything that brought you this far.

The Fae. The Jellyfish. The stars. The Berries. The battles. The discoveries. The deeply suspicious shopkeeper.

Every ridiculous victory and every moment you probably should not have survived.

The Astral Sea stirs around you.

You've made it this far.

You're not stopping here.

ending.heading: Astral Awakening
ending.effect: Restored 25 HP + 25 Mana | Next offensive roll +2
